notes.title: Update: 5.4.0.0 – Season 18
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/d5b9520944e7da757dade3fe3c9201989ff8cc55.png[/img]

Realmers!

S18 is finally here bringing loads of QoL and an Eternal Frost with it With a brand new battle pass filled with holiday goodies and 2 new class reworks!

But that’s not all throughout the season we will have the return of some fan-favorite events such as Sub Zero, Oryxmas, and the Oryxmania Rumble all with brand-new twists! Continue reading below to find out what’s available RIGHT NOW:

[h2]Season 18 - The Eternal Frost[/h2]

[i]Millennia ago, an unforgiving ice age nearly consumed the realm, erasing countless ancient tribes and leaving only a few to endure the frozen desolation. Though the frost mysteriously receded, its shadow looms again with the return of the Harbinger of Frost, his hollow, icy heart untouched by mercy. Flanked by his devious advisor and chilling allies like the Permafrost Lord and Jack Frost, the Harbinger seeks to plunge the world into an Eternal Frost, commanding a relentless legion of cold.

Now, only the players can rise as the realm's final hope, battling through frostbitten legions and unyielding commanders to shatter the Harbinger’s icy grip and prevent the world from succumbing to a frozen eternity.[/i]

These patch notes are very long so we’ve summarized everything into a quick overview below:

[list]
[*] Class reworks: Both the Huntress and the Samurai received overhauls to their abilities to improve their game feel and have them feel as powerful as our other more modern classes.
[*] QoL: More quality of life improvements than can be counted! But to name a few; Greater Potions now only count as 1 slot in the potion rack, a new button has been added to the potion rack to auto consume all potions of a stat type until maxed, improvements to the visibility of locked doors and keys in Davy Jones’ Locker.
[*] New Realms: We say goodbye to the old realms and now all realms that spawn will be new realms! Additionally, a new feature to have some control over which encounters spawn has been introduced.
[*] Holiday Cheer: Oryxmas Nexus and a Frozen Castle have made their return.
[*] Splash: New holiday-themed splash art has been added to the game.
[/list]

[h2]Battle Pass[/h2]

As always, a new season means a new Battle Pass. Start your journey on a fresh new seasonal character, finish Missions, and gain some tasty Battle Pass EXP.


[h2]Missions[/h2]

New Season means new Missions! It’s time for you to collect all those rewards and finish your Battle Pass on the way. 


Additionally, we have added a new tab for you to more easily see your active missions as well as which missions you’re able to claim!


[h2]Crucible[/h2]

A new Crucible appears with this Season. Like last season, this crucible can not be removed once active, so choose wisely!

[list]
[*] Reduced healing by 25% from pets, potions, and external sources.
[*] Reduced defense by 5
[*] 10% BXP boost
[*] 10% EXP boost
[*] 20% loot boost
[/list]

Additionally, Crucible Rings have made a return and can be acquired every 18 hours by completing the last mission on the crucible branch of the mission tree!

[h2]Nexus[/h2]

While Christmas is still a bit away, the Nexus is already overflowing with holiday cheer!

[h2]The Realms[/h2]

When we released the Realm Rework to open beta in April of this year, we continued to keep the old realms open for the players who wanted to stick with the more polished and less buggy realms (at the time). From all the feedback the players have given us over the past 8 months, we were able to continually improve upon the Beta Realms to the point where we now feel comfortable with the Beta Realms being the definitive Realm of the Mad God experience. Starting in Season 18: The Eternal Frost, we will be sunsetting the Old Realms and have a minimum of 2 of the Reworked Realms.

While we are taking the Realm Rework out of beta, we are not done making improvements either! Here are a few of them that are available with this release:

[b]Reworked Encounter Spawning Mechanism[/b]

[list]
[*] Encounters will now have a 25% chance of spawning when reaching a certain amount of score within a biome.
[*] If players are looking to fight Cube Gods, for example, they should go to the Sprite Forest to guarantee that a Sprite Forest encounter will spawn.
[*] Only 1 Encounter of a given type can be active at once, see what strategies you can make!
[*] New Fame bonuses have been added for killing enemies within a given biome.
[*] The “Cavalry Lance” biome UT has had its effect activated.
[/list]

Additionally, for the Eternal Frost Season beacon guardians have received some festive reskins! If you’re lucky, you may find yourself looting an Oryxmas Ornament from the Veteran beacon encounters 👀.
[h2]
Class Reworks[/h2]

Next up are our class reworks of the Huntress and Samurai!  When it comes to the Huntress we wanted to make its AoE / Trapping capabilities feel more impactful in the current era. To do this we have made two major changes to the way her abilities work:

[list]
[*] Like all of our previous class reworks, we have added StatMod scaling to the Trap ability, allowing it to scale any part of its effects with a chosen stat.
[*] Secondly, when an enemy activates a trap, it will cause an AoE explosion like it currently does on prod. Additionally, a number of enemies (dependent on the trap type and player stats) closest to the epicenter of the explosion will have a “Sticky Bomb” attached to them. This sticky bomb will grow in size and then shortly deal damage in an AoE around the enemy.
[*] Finally, we have buffed a handful of bows that we felt were underperforming
[/list]
[olist]
[*] Warmonger: 10Dex while in-combat→ -5 Dex while in-combat
[*] Warmonger (Rehearsal): 10Dex while in-combat→ -5 Dex while in-combat
[*] Thousand Shot: Now ignores enemies defense.
[*] Bow of the Void: 5.6 range, wiggly → 6 range, less wiggly
[*] Resplendent Bow:  No longer removes 10 dex from player when hit + 50 min damage
[*] Coral Bow: Increased min and max damage by 5.
[/olist]

For the Samurai, while we did feel that this class left a little to be desired, we also did not feel that it needed a complete overhaul of the Wakizashi ability. For this reason, the Samurai class  ability received what we will now be called a Class Modernization. 

A class Modernization aims to improve classes that we feel need just a small bump in order to increase their enjoyability. In the case of the Samurai, we have added statMod scaling to its ability which will allow the player to increase the abilities strength and the number of projectiles that the Wakizashi will fire. 

Lastly, for all tiered Wakizashi’s we have changed the angle at which the projectiles fire in order to improve the game feel when using this ability

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

For this holiday season, one of our core aims is to give ourselves the proper time to add a lot of well-needed Quality of Life to improve different areas of the game. 

[list]
[*] The maximum number of equipable emotes has been increased to 8.
[*] In the potion vault, a new button has been added to consume all pots of a given type until the character is maxed.
[*] Greater potions now only take up 1 inventory slot instead of two.
[*] The “Favorite” feature has been expanded to titles and entrance effects.
[*] When favoriting a title or an entrance effect, all newly created characters will automatically have these cosmetics equipped.
[*] A new “Blank” prefix and suffix titles have been added for players who don’t want to use both kinds of titles when customizing their characters.
[*] A new “The” prefix title has been added for a similar reason.
[*] In Davy Jones’s locker, locked doors that have been found will have an icon on the Mini Map until the door gets unlocked.
[*] Each Key in Davy Jones’ Locker has been given a unique shape that matches its associated lock icon to assist colorblind users.
[*] Davy Jones’ can now have Curse applied by Mystic orbs.
[*] You can now gift friends skins when purchasing in the shop.
[*] Portals of Cowardice will now spawn after the first or second boss of the Secluded Thicket is completed for cases where the player would like to leave early.
[*] Dazed Effect has been removed from El Dorado’s grenade attacks.
[*] All tiered armors have had their tiers reduced by one to make Weapon and Armor tiers consistent.
[*] For instance, previously the Tier 1 “Robe of the Neophyte” is now Tier 0.
[*] All items will continue to drop from where they previously dropped.
[*] All newly created characters will start with a T0 armor.
[*] Seasonal Spoils Chest sprite has been revamped.
[*] Seasonal Character Converter has been given a unique sprite.
[*] High Tech Terror:
[*] In High Tech Terror when there is only 1 switch left, F.E.R.A.L. will no longer move to that pool and prevent players from progressing.
[*] A.E.G.I.S. Shields are now prevented from targetting the southwest switch on initial spawn.
[*] M.E.R.V. now fires an indicator on his path before moving.
[*] Fungal / Crystal Caerns:
[*] Dwarf Miner Encounter now properly always shows a minimap icon.
[*] Crystal Cavern Crystals have had their projectile speeds reduced by 40 to match those of the ones in Fungal Caverns.
[*] Reduced the Stun Duration of Large Red Mushrooms.
[*] Reduced the Weak Duration of Large Purple Mushrooms.
[*] Fixed stacked shots when fighting against the Crystalized Fish.
[*] Increased the size of the Crystallized Scorpion while in his clone phase.
[*] When getting teleported to the Crystallized Entity, all players are Invulnerable.
[*] Reduced the length of Ocean Trench, Sulfurous Wetlands Third Dimension, and Abyss of Demons.
[*] Reduce enemy density and damage of Stinky tiles in Wetlands.
[*] Reduced invulnerability times of both bosses in Wetlands.
[*] Lowered the number of phases per fight of Heart of the Wetlands to 6 from 7.
[*] Increased the chance for a treasure room spawn in Abyss of Demons.
[*] Readded Shadow Cube Serpent bite animation.
[*] Stasising Anti-Spectors just before Oryx Dies should no longer cause them to stay alive longer.
[*] Key Fairies drop a random key instead of a Mystery Key item.
[*] Key Fairy key drops are now guaranteed, there is also an additional chance for 2 more players to receive a key.
[*] Key fairies now grant players dust, amount, and kind depending on tier.
[*] Completing Advance Nest or Advanced Steamworks grants players an additional Exaltation.
[*] A class bias has been added to Oryx 3 to make it more likely you receive an ability for your class.
[/list]

notes.title: Update: 5.3.0.0 – Aliens and QoL
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/b17025ab0a629702e888cb32cb15140d59e618e0.png[/img]

Hello, skeptical Realmers!

The Halloween Event has come to an end, and it's time to jump in the second part of Season 17. The second part of the battlepass is going live today, together with a new batch of missions to help you completing it. Also, we have a bunch of improvements for the Spectral Penitentiary, and Quality of Life changes!

[h3]Alien Event[/h3]

The visitors are back! You can find them strolling around the Realm, searching for samples.

[h3]Realm Events[/h3]

You will be able to encounter the upgraded Commander Calbrik in New Realms in the Abandoned City region. The alien event will start after the Realm Score reaches 65 000!

[h3]Dungeon Events[/h3]

During the whole event starting on the 5th of November until November 19 we will have events in the: 

[list]
[*] Malogia - Chest Events + 25% Chance to spawn another Alien Wormhole Mod + Guaranteed Uranium Shard x1
[*] Untaris - Chest Events + 25% Chance to spawn another Alien Wormhole Mod + Guaranteed Uranium Shard x1
[*] Katalund - Chest Events + 25% Chance to spawn another Alien Wormhole Mod + Guaranteed Uranium Shard x1
[*] Forax - Chest Events + 25% Chance to spawn another Alien Wormhole Mod + Guaranteed Uranium Shard x1
[/list]

During the first week of the event starting on November 5th until November 12th we will have events in the following dungeons:

[list]
[*] Snake Pit - 1.5x Loot and EXP
[*] The Third Dimension - Chest Event + 50% Chance to spawn another Alien Wormhole Mod + Guaranteed Uranium Shard x1
[*] Moonlight Village - Chest Event + 85% Chance to spawn another Alien Wormhole Mod + Guaranteed Uranium Shard x3
[*] 
[/list]

During the second week of the event starting on November 12th until November 19th we will have events in the following dungeons:

[list]
[*] Ancient Ruins - 1.5x Loot and EXP
[*] Mountain Temple - Chest Event + 50% Chance to spawn another Alien Wormhole Mod + Guaranteed Uranium Shard x1
[*] The Nest - Chest Event + 70% Chance to spawn another Alien Wormhole Mod + Guaranteed Uranium Shard x2
[*] 
[/list]

[h3]New Alien Shinies[/h3]

[list]
[*] Shiny Fire Blade
[*] Shiny Blazon Bow
[*] Shiny Foramite Staff
[*] Shiny Dueling Daggers
[*] 
[/list]

[h3]Rat Minigame[/h3]

UGC veteran contributor Mizumi has brought you another addition to the Realm Rework! After liberating the beacon in the Abandoned City, a quirky fellow named Herman will recruit you on an endeavor for rat hunting!

[previewyoutube=UZJy4e8bk1Y;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Season 17 Part 2[/h3]

The first part of this season is coming to a close, and it’s time start with the second one! You can continue using your current seasonal characters and complete new Missions, progress in a fresh Battle Pass, and hunt for new shiny.
 
[h3]Item Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Kogbold Multitool Blueprint now counts as a Realm White for forge.
[*] Skull of Corrupted Souls shiny now counts as a Cult White for forge.
[*] Plague Poison Shiny now has the correct damage value.
[/list]

[h3]Spectral Penitentiary Revisions[/h3]

[list]
[*] UGC designer Marshmalla has been reading all the player feedback and has brought another wave of game feel and balance revisions to the Penitentiary.
[/list]

[h3]Item Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed Command Cornea reducing player weapon damage to 0%.
[*] Reduced MP cost of Overwhelming Axehead from 200 > 150
[*] Changed Cackling Straitjacket's Generalized Insanity proc to an On Shoot, proc chance nerfed to 1% (activates much more consistently)
[*] Sinister Syringes VIT reduction reduced from -100 > -50
[*] Damnation VIT reduction reduced from -100 > -50
[*] Ocular Entrapment slow AoE and Eyebawl detection range increased from 1.5 > 3 tiles
[*] Pandemic Poison MP cost reduced from 100 > 90 to match Plague Poison (this was an oversight, my bad)
[*] Increased Boundless Vessel's WIS bonus from 15 > 20
[*] Completely reworked Jailer's Scythe, fixed XP bonus, and now counts as a Realm White
[/list]

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Changed hardmode HP multiplier from 1.5x > 1.35x
[*] Slightly increased Administration Branch (North) hardmode timer
[*] Nerfed some large and medium enemies across all branches to be less mean (Wandering Wailer no longer petrifies, Elite Skeletal Guard is less lethal, etc.)
[*] Standardized decoy deletion ranges and cooldowns across all bosses and phases to be more reasonable (decoys are easier to use, normal mode only)
[*] Lobotomik is no longer immune to being slowed
[*] Reduced sicken duration on Lobotomik's cauldron phase outer turret projectiles (3s > 1.6s)
[*] Oculon no longer starts rotating at the same point every time during her clones (red) phase
[*] Removed unintuitive melee-range sicken AoEs from Oculon's radar (green) phase
[*] Oculon can no longer roll into double walls in normal mode during her chomp (brown) phase
[*] Lowered base HP on Oculon's green counter eyeball during her absorb (red) phase
[*] Nerfed damage on Oculon's green star projectiles (from minions) in her traffic (green) phase
[*] Doubled lifetime of initial indicator shapes during Oculon's memory (brown) phase so they are easier to memorize
[*] Murcian and his keys now move slightly faster depending on their rotation radius
[*] Murcian now slows down when a player is within 5 tiles of him for more accessible damage uptime (pre-50% only)
[*] Murcian's petrify projectiles no longer deal damage
[*] Murcian's clones in his Skuld mirror phase are now damageable and explode into their usual AoE when killed
[*] Murcian no longer shoots during his roulette phase
[*] Updated Murcian's movement in some phases where it was difficult to follow him (padlock clock, roulette)
[*] Murcian now transitions into his final phase immediately upon reaching his 10% threshold
[*] Murcian no longer forces you to wait another full light cycle after killing all the keys during Afraid of the Dark
[*] Reduced shot density in HM Afraid of the Dark
[*] Murcian now has a 50% chance to provide an additional Attack exaltation in hardmode
[*] Murcian now drops greater potions in both normal and hardmode
[*] All bosses have received tiered drop rate increases
[/list]

[h3]QoL Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Spectral Jailer now has a unique minimap icon for easier hunting
[*] Spectral Penitentiary now drops from Skeletal Centipede (replaces Crawling Depths drop)
[*] Rations can now be shared and traded between fellow inmates (Spectral Prison Ration is now tradeable)
[*] Boss teleporters now teleport you 2 tiles below the center of the room to prevent unintended deaths
[*] Moved cowardice portal a couple tiles north to prevent accidentally entering it when spamming the return teleporter (my bad y'all)
[*] Torture Branch (West) slimes now have a 5s timer upon leaving their detection radius before disappearing
[*] Torture Branch (West) slimes now spawn 0.2s faster
[*] Enemies now enter a new retreat state after entering a switch's range to prevent enemies from crowding in front of hallways (particularly the first room of a branch)
[*] Lowered size of Gretch's shovel phase indicators and increased visibility of AoE
[*] Lowered opacity of red floor indicators to be easier on the eyes
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added Penitent Frog Pet Skin to Murcian's drop table (oops, it was on the quest chest at least)
[*] Fixed an incorrect description on the Vial of Soul Extract
[*] The Vial of Soul Extract can no longer be stored in pet saddlebags
[*] Fixed a particular NPC's room to now be normally accessible
[*] Hardmode Murcian now grants dust
[*] Fixed a walkable black tile in a Garden Branch (South) room
[*] Fixed an Administration Branch (North) room to no longer have chairs spawning on turrets
[*] Lobotomik and Oculon now properly delete objective minimap icons in their boss room upon activation
[*] Added a failsafe to Lobotomik to prevent him from dying in the wrong spot in some instances
[*] Known Issues
[*] Turrets may sometimes not spawn in Administration Branch (North) end rooms. Still investigating this issue.
[/list]

notes.title: Update: 5.2.0.0.0 - Halloween Event
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/a2a2c3a09cd94d054fb6765c116031fbbe61ff0d.png[/img]

Spooky Realmers!

Halloween is upon us! Totalia and the Zombie Horde are invading our Realms. Go fight off the hordes of zombies, loot Candy Piles and Event Chests, finish brand-new missions, and take part in our Free Campaign for some tasty rewards! Additionally, nearly 200 Skins will be discounted in our shop!
[h2]
Halloween Event[/h2]

It seems like every year the Realm gets invaded by hordes of Zombies, and a Witch, while Oryx is busy jumping into his favorite Halloween costume. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/877deef418d916711699c521bf7d081520b8d869.png[/img]

You will be able to encounter Totalia the Malevolent in New Realms. With a new loot table, facing off against the wandering witch will be much more rewarding than last year, including a class-biased drop for Halloween Costumes and more! 

She will spawn depending on the current Realm Score:
[list]
[*] Totalia will spawn at 15, 50, 85 % Realm Score.
[/list]

Zombie Hordes are appearing all over the New Realms! If you’ve been looking for a way to get Soul Collector Engravings, it may be time to consult the undead Bonegrind! Beat them and collect some skins and more!

[list]
[*] The Zombie Horde will spawn at 40, 60, 80 % Realm Score. 
[/list]
[h3]Realm Dust Drop[/h3]

Realm Encounters and Beacon Guards will drop green, red, and purple dust during the event. Some of them will also be wearing their Halloween costumes to better fit into the Halloween Season!
Realm Encounters and Beacon Guards will also have a chance to drop items like stat maxing candies.

Beacon Guards that normally have a chance to drop the Angelic Bard Set will now also have a chance to drop the pieces for the Demon Guitarist Set.

[h2]Dungeon Events[/h2]
[h3]Chest Events [/h3]

The event will be available for 3 weeks. The following dungeons will have chest events: Those dungeons will drop Twisted Coins, used to complete quests at the Tinkerer. All dungeons drop them even if the chest event is not active during the week.

Week 1:
[list]
[*] Snake Pit
[*] Manor of the Immortals
[*] Haunted Cemetery
[*] The Shatters
[/list]

Week 2:
[list]

[/list]

Week 3:
[list]

[*] Crawling Depths
[*] Kogbold Steamworks, Advanced Kogbold Steamworks
[/list]

[h3]Candy Piles[/h3]

When you defeat the boss in an event dungeon, there will be a chance for a big pile of candy to spawn in the boss room.

Weirdly enough this Pile of Candy drops some rather special rewards!


[b]Candy in Dungeons Drop:[/b]

[h3]Loot Broom[/h3]

Loot Broom will sometimes spawn in rooms of the event dungeons. So watch out and don't forget to beat this scary broom to receive some nice rewards.

[b]Loot Broom Drops:[/b]

Rewards:

Realm Token will be more accessible when playing through the realm.

[/list]

[h3]Sales[/h3]

[b]Free Pack[/b]
Until the 22nd of October you will be able to claim this free bundle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/e7538250d5f5e6a6556beae80a6d10d0468a6472.png[/img]


We are getting closer and closer to the spooky season and have some exciting new Halloween Pet Skins and Pet Arcane Style bundles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/35b3ea186649bd122e0acab77b6730ab91f08d88.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/d397e946503304501710704e41747ef96c89fea3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/cb9e6955d580c0bda6b04a0f3379015a00c5dfa5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/25f0ef4c730da52eb4d055a52212b8f95d3673e4.png[/img]

[h3]ST Sales[/h3]

[list]
[*] Halloween Treasure Box – Chance to get Halloween ST Chests and Sets!
[*] Demon Guitarist Bard ST
[*] Cursed Grimoire ST Box - Chance to get an item from the Archexorcist Priest or Cursed Cursebreaker Huntress sets!
[*] Silver Urn ST Box - Chance to get an item from the Lycan Warrior or Ghostly Banshee Summoner sets!
[*] Eerie Music Box ST - Chance to get an item from the Incubus Sorcerer or Lei Gong Ninja sets!
[*] Demon Pumpkin ST Box - Chance to get an item from the Scarecrow Trickster or Unholy Paladin sets!
[*] Haunted Tombstone ST Box - Chance to get an item from the Paranormal Wizard or Reaper Necromancer sets!
[*] Witch's Skull ST Box - Chance to get an item from the Reanimated Archer or Totalia Mystic sets!
[/list]

[h3]Skin Discounts [/h3]

We have a store-wide sale of nearly 200 Halloween-themed skins, which will be available throughout the event and end on November 5th, 2024!

[h2]Halloween Season Updates[/h2]

Have you tried “trick-or-treating” yet? If you wear a Halloween costume, change your skin with it, and then ask nicely for candy, some spooky characters (4 of them to be exact) will give you some treats! Or they might just hand out some tricks as well!
[h3]
Secret Powers Unlocked[/h3]

[list]
[*] All Halloween costumes have had their Secret Power procs unlocked! These special effects will consume 1/4th of your meter on ability used to create a powerful themed attack.
[*] Halloween costumes will still change your skin free of meter charge, but will now last 60 seconds with a cooldown of 30 seconds.
[*] The Halloween costume maximum meter was raised by 50% and the bonus meter from Candies was also raised by 50%. This can also be seen as a reduction in effectiveness from non-Candy sources to charge the costume meters.
[*] When activating your secret powers, your characters might become a bit more talkative!
[/list]

[h3]Balancing Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hallows Horseman HP is reduced to 7500 and spawns 30% more often.
[*] Graverobber Lantern Holder now drops Haunted Cemetery at a 100% rate.
[*] Bug Fixes
[*] Risen Hell candies should no longer have abnormally high HP.
[*] Candies that spawn from dungeons or trick-or-treating will allow 1 second of damage before becoming killable, to allow players to more easily get soulbound damage.
[*] The Exaltation Banner mod in The Shatters will now randomly choose between an ATT, LIFE, or MANA banner.
[/list]

[h2]Spectral Penitentiary Revisions[/h2]

Marshmalla, UGC creator of the Spectral Penitentiary dungeon, has been reading and reviewing all of your feedback.

[list]
[*] Mark of the Soulwarden and Vial of Soul Extract can now be placed in Forge Material Storage.
[*] HP Scaling has been reduced in a way that benefits mid-size groups.
[*] Branch speedrun timers and group scaling are both more lenient to allow easier speedrun access.
[*] All minibosses damage cap at 50% HP instead of 30%.
[*] Some large enemies (Admin / Torture branches) deal less damage.
[*] Removed unnecessary invulnerability periods from many enemies.
[*] Dead Medic no longer inflicts Hallucinating, and now inflicts Hexed.
[*] Oculon traffic phase has reduced damage.
[*] Lobotomik sutures phase has reduced damage and increased pattern gap size.
[*] Lobotomik's crab transformation should no longer get stuck.
[*] All minibosses have new dialogue that indicate speedrun route has been achieved.
[/list]

notes.title: Update: 5.2.0.0.0 - Spooky Season 17
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/feb25bb73fbf756ccb90b8e1f39ffb1a3cba6401.png[/img]

Realmers!

Season 17 is all about Trick-o-Treat and QoL! From a new Battle Pass and Missions to a brand-new exaltation dungeon and several reworks, this update has it all! 

But this is just the beginning. In two weeks time, you’ll get to experience the proper Halloween Event with more content for you to try out. Find out what you’ll get to play TODAY below:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6agGM40x1Q8

[h2]Season 17 - Totalia’s Trick-o-Treat![/h2]

These patch notes are very large, so we’ve summarized everything in a quick overview below:

[list]
[*] Spectral Penitentiary, the new Exaltation dungeon, releases today and can be found in Veteran Biomes.
[*] Many dungeon reworks/QoL, including Haunted Cemetery, Manor of the Immortals, Puppet Master’s Theatre, and more!
[*] Many technical and balance improvements, including Realm Proximity HP Scaling, Ring Rework, Transcendent Rings, and more!
[*] 6 new Shiny UTs have arrived:
Tezcacoatl’s Tail, Scepter of Rust, Soul’s Guidance, Sporous Spray Spell, Seal of Blasphemous Prayer, and Volcanic Sheath
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/f316391f8169271b84f347f6592882cc7d36963a.png[/img] 
[list]
[*] Halloween Nexus and Parasite Castle return to haunt you for the whole season!
[*] Look for delicious Candies spinning through all Adept / Veteran biomes, and try to hunt them for their rare and powerful drops, including Biome UTs, Costumes, and Extreme Candies!
[*] New splash art is available upon loading the game.
[*] Two new Skins and 1 Pet skins from the Celestial Quests.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/46aa9dbe83bac702fcbcc90e566720a17782b43c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/c4515efaa19054c16de5294c94d35b128c83fecb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/8283355141136ec06928853362f5ff75b42fa6a3.png[/img]


[h3]Battle Pass[/h3]

As always, a new season means a new Battle Pass. Start your journey on a fresh new seasonal character, finish Missions, and gain some tasty Battle Pass EXP.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/9e87c3e2f2e020348057b0d65dd25a490ab8a734.png[/img]

Have a look at all BP Rewards: https://imgur.com/gallery/season-17-battle-pass-Jps7tn7


[h3]Missions[/h3]

New Season means new Missions! It's time for you to collect all those rewards and finish your Battle Pass on the way. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/5743090e062dafbfe8e2e5264700da1c8aec4ae9.png[/img]

[h3]Crucible[/h3]

A new Crucible appears with this Season. This time around it's for seasonal characters only and it cannot be removed! So choose wisely. 

+3% Current Health Damage to all projectiles received.
+20% Loot Bonus
+10% XP Bonus
+10% BXP Bonus

Only seasonal characters can enter this Crucible, and once the Crucible is applied to the character, it cannot be removed.

[h3]Dungeoneer PPE Contest[/h3]

The Dungeoneer Discord is running another version of their PPE Contest for this Season! From 01.10 until 20.10 you will be able to take part in collecting fresh gear on a seasonal character and compete in a Leaderboard to win some Realm Gold!

Part of the prize pool is sponsored by DECA, so make sure to check out the Contest on the Discord: https://discord.gg/x9xdZy2


[h3]Nexus[/h3]

While Halloween is still a bit away, the Nexus was already invaded by the Halloween Spirits and hopefully we will be able to get rid of them once Halloween is over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/9105d633485305e293586cd4cf753edd3d0626f1.png[/img]

[h2]Spectral Penitentiary[/h2]

While Skuld’s magic could easily manipulate the souls of beings across the realm, the emergence of powerful new forces has threatened to alter the natural order of death.

In order to address this unprecedented new danger, Skuld declared an order to reopen the very dimension that had locked away her past.

…

Welcome to the Spectral Penitentiary! I'm Marshmalla, and I’ll be your guidance counselor in your journey to fulfill your afterlife sentence. Before we begin the tour, I’d like to give a shoutout to our benefactors, as we wouldn’t be able to operate without them.

Lead - Marshmalla
Art - TLMaelstrom, Idontgiveawhale, Sheepsmall
Special Thanks - stellalumi, Kiddforce, Toastrz, Dystratix

Without further ado, let’s get started!

Contrary to the usual event boss, the dungeon will drop from an uncommon enemy appearing in all veteran biomes, but that doesn’t mean they won’t go down without a fight. After all, Skuld doesn’t want to make too much of a fuss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/54b67a2bc501a5313d4e9d26d4d28cd729b6bb76.png[/img]

The first place you’ll be sent after your arrival will be the courtyard, where you’ll be greeted by our wonderful Soulwarden Murcian. He’ll fill you in on some details about how things operate on the Penitentiary before sending you on your way to one of the four unique branches of the dungeon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/cf6a6636f6053f2c59f48edcb2759cc6eb7ca49c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/c81dab6c75c5ad895d4b390fef10603a9f4785f4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/2e7eb6608d1087e0229a8f1af4d2e759c23ac719.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/dee4e0009b5769efc613a20557d55d67f47ff7a3.png[/img]

After exiting a branch’s starting room, you’ll be given a specific job to do before you’re able to interact with the branch’s boss. The bar in the top left corner will track your progress along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/28e622b0d1449486866b16d8122a2f67339baddc.png[/img]

Bosses will administer harder challenges and more rewards to those that can prove their capability to complete tasks under an allocated time limit. The more people you have, however, the quicker you’ll need to work!

After visiting two out of the four branches, you’ll get to participate in a meeting with the Soulwarden himself. He’s delighted to have you here and wants to be sure that those who are worthy will continue to better themselves into even stronger citizens of the realm. To assist in this endeavor, Murcian will reward an Attack Exaltation to those who can pass his examination.

This will conclude our tour of the Spectral Penitentiary! I hope that you all enjoy the hard work we put into our facility and settle down nicely, as we expect your stay to be PERMANENT.

And just so you remember...

[b]NOBODY ESCAPES THE SPECTRAL PENITENTIARY.[/b]

[h2]Technical Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Proximity HP Scaling has been added to New Realms. Encounters gain +10% HP for each player within 50 tiles.
[*] Prior to this change, encounters would gain HP for every player in the entire Realm.
[*] New Realm Encounter spawns are limited to unique alive encounters. 
[*] What this means is that there can no longer be two Ancient Kaijus on the map at the same time.
[*] Minimap zoom scaling has been improved for use in the Realm and in other large maps.
[*] When swapping between items that grant MaxHP / MaxMP bonuses, your stat value in either of these gauges will no longer be lost on swap.
[*] Items that change your skin, such as Halloween Bottles or Evolutionary Records, can now overwrite each other on demand.
[/list]

[h2]Item / Character Balance Changes[/h2]
[h3]Ring Rework[/h3]
[list]
[*] New T7 (Transcendent) rings will drop from Oryx the Mad God 3, The Forgotten King, and Kitsune Umi.
[*] All tiered rings have received a statistical balance update in which all of them have a MaxHP and MaxMP component.
[*] Health and Magic rings received extra adjustments and have reduced stat totals on their main stat.
[*] XP Bonus and Feed power have been revised on tiered rings.
[*] Bloodshed Ring gained +2 WIS.
[*] Magical Lodestone gained +30 HP.
[*] Sourcestone gained two new procs: “Source of Life” and “Source of Magic”
[*] Omnipotence Ring gained +10 HP, +10 MP, +1 DEF, +1 SPD, +2 VIT, +2 WIS.
[*] Ring of Decades and The Forgotten Ring now have 160 HP.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/6522e0723111e5cb37f016c93d89f7fec0a1d4ea.png[/img]

[h3]Class Max HP Revision[/h3]
[list]
As a result of HP loss from tiered health rings, all classes are receiving a minimum of +30 HP to their maximum HP. Certain classes may receive more than +30.
[*] Maximum HP is standardized across classes based on their weapon type:
[*] Sword / Katana: 800 maximum health
[*] Dagger / Bow: 750 maximum health
[*] Staff / Wand: 700 maximum health
[/list]
[h3]
Tiered Drop Table Revision[/h3]
[list]
T5 (Exalted) rings no longer drop from Adept content. This affects the following dungeons:

[*] Abyss of Demons
[*] Cursed Library
[*] Haunted Cemetery
[*] Mad Lab
[*] Puppet Master’s Theatre
[/list]
[list]
Davy Jones’ Locker received a full-tiered drop table revision:

[*] T9 / T10 weapons
[*] T10 / T11 armors
[*] T4 / T5 abilities
[*] T4 / T5 rings
[/list]
[list]
[*] Dungeon Mod “The Wanderer” boss can now drop both T5 and T6 rings.
[*] Oryx the Mad God 2 now drops T6 rings.
[*] Moonlight Village has revised and improved tiered drop rates for:
[*] T13 weapons
[*] T6 rings
[*] Beginner Quest Chest no longer drops T4 rings.
[*] Standard Quest Chest no longer drops T5 rings.
[*] Royal Epic Quest Chest now drops T7 rings.
[*] Moonlit Epic Quest Chest now drops T6 rings.
[/list]
[h3]ST Drop Table Revision[/h3]
[list]
[*] Spectral Penitentiary bosses will drop the following Gen 3 ST Shards:
[*] Spellbound Soulthief Trickster (from Soulwarden Murcian)
[*] Plague Doctor Priest (from Doctor Lobotomik and Griefkeeper Zole)
[*] Alchemist Assassin (from Groundskeeper Gretch and Overseer Oculon)
[*] Astral Arcanist Mystic shards will now drop from Oryx the Mad God 3.
[*] Oryx’s Sanctuary bosses have received revised Gen 3 Shard drops:

[list][*] Shaman Necromancer (from Archbishop Leucoryx and Treasurer Gemsbok)
[*] Mad Minotaur Knight (from Chief Beisa and Chancellor Dammah)
[*] Oryx’s Sanctuary mini bosses retain their increased ST Shard drop rate.[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Haunted Cemetery Reconstruction[/h2]

[b]For this Halloween season, we decided to give the Haunted Cemetery a reconstruction. We added new art, fresh enemy behaviors (make sure to not lose your favorite character), and much more![/b]

[list]
[*] Haunted Cemetery received a full redesign with new art and enemy behaviors.
[*] Haunted Cemetery now has the following level structure:
[list]

[*]Gates (waves)
[*]Gates Boss (Troll Matriarch or Ghost Bride)
[*]Graves (waves)
[*]Graves Boss (Grave Caretaker or Pumpkin King)
[*]Mausoleum Boss (Ghost of Skuld)
[/list]

[*] Only large minions must be killed to advance each wave, and waves can advance if you take too long.
[*] Numerous pacing/timing adjustments to the zone structures.
[*] The teleporter system has been reworked for ease of use and to avoid “trapping” players.
[*] Plague Poison base damage increased by 200.
[*] Resurrected Warrior’s Armor WIS changed from 20 -> 10.
[*] Resurrected Warrior’s “Mystic Gem” proc now grants Energized.
[*] Amulet of Dispersion has a new proc “Forgotten Power”.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/cd541a258aaa125b937b0653cf3b6db68c6554b4.png[/img]

[h2]Dungeon Changes[/h2]

[b]Several dungeons are receiving changes. From a brand new boss fight in the Manor of the Immortals, to new Items and QoL changes to make the dungeons faster, we have it all.[/b]

[list]
Manor of the Immortals Changes

[*] Lord Ruthven boss fight has been reworked.
[*] Main branch length reduced by 10%.
[*] Sub-branch length reduced by 37%
[*] The 4x4 bookcase structure now has a chance of containing a Coffin.
[*] A new type of treasure room can appear at the end of sub-branches.
[*] Lil Feratu can now spawn in the dungeon generation.
[*] Armor Guards and Hellhounds can now drop Bone Dagger.
[/list]

[h3]Undead Lair Changes & New Items[/h3]

[list]
[*] A new item, Wandering Souls Spell (by UGC member Tyii) now drops from Septavius the Ghost God.
[*] A new item, Ring of Skeletal Specters (by UGC member Mathician) now drops from the Lair Spectral Skeleton.
[*] Main branch length reduced by 10%.
[*] Sub branch length reduced by 16%
[*] Lair Spectral Skeleton is significantly more common.
[*] Reduced orbiting speed of outermost minions.
[/list]

[h3]Puppet Master’s Theatre Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Main branch length was reduced by 20%.
[*] Sub-branch length reduced by 28%.
[*] Damage reduced by 15 across most attacks.
[*] Knight puppet shield effect changed from Armor Broken to Stunned.
[*] The Archer puppet arrow effect changed from Paralyzed to Slowed.
[*] Puppet Master and Clone yellow spinner effect changed from Paralyzed to Dazed.
[*] Sorcerer puppet bombs have been adjusted for visibility.
[*] Oryx Puppet artifacts no longer seek other faraway Oryx Puppets.
[/list]

[h3]Fungal & Crystal Cavern Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Main branch length reduced.
[*] Only 20 crystals are required to open the boss room.
[*] Ring of Decades has received a major drop rate boost.
[/list]

[h3]The Shatters Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] The Forgotten King now grants a LIFE and MANA exaltation at a 100% chance, as opposed to an ATTACK exaltation.
[*] Twilight Archmage’s ATTACK exaltation remains unchanged.
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]

[list]
[*] We are aware of an issue where using Evolutionary Records on a Priest with default skin does not change the skin back after the transformation expires.
[*] Exaltation Banner dungeon mods for The Shatters are not updated for the new exaltation spread and will only give ATT exaltations.
[*] Halloween Costume UT armors have placeholder text descriptions.
[*] T7 and other tiered rings have misconfigured dust reroll costs.
[*] The missions “Penitentiary Grand Tour” and “Terrors of the Night” may sometimes not properly complete for players.
[*] Veteran Beacon Guardians currently do not apply proximity health scaling.
[*] Haunted Cemetery boss minions currently give incorrect EXP values.
[/list]

[h3]Future Updates[/h3]

[list]
[*] Expect more of the classic Halloween visitors, such as Totalia and Zombie Horde during the Halloween Event starting 2 weeks after this release!
[*] A couple new Halloween STs are coming around the corner… are you prepared for them?
[*] The Halloween Costumes may unlock their secret powers around this time…
[*] Wait, there’s actually trick or treating?! No one told me about this!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/e2d8495f547c488be5f39557fca1b3e48e714ab0.png[/img]


Hello swashbuckling Realmers!

Avast, and other piratical lingo! For this year’s Talk Like a Pirate day, we have a treasure chest bursting with new items and content for you to explore.

[h3]Treasure Chests And Pirate Quests[/h3]
The pirates of the Realm have hidden treasure in the following dungeons:

Pirate Cave
Ancient Ruins
Cave of A Thousand Treasures
Cursed Library
Davy Jones' Locker
Woodland Labyrinth
Deadwater Docks
Oryx's Sanctuary
The Shatters
Lost Halls

These chests will spawn between 3 and 5 guards to protect them when they are encountered. Only once these swashbucklers are dead will the chest become vulnerable to attacks. Inside you will find an array of loot as well as Captain’s Coins. These can be consumed as part of the free event for further rewards. The higher the level of the dungeon, the more coins the chests can contain.

You can also steal the eyepatches of famous pirates from the following dungeons:

Davy Jones’ Locker
Ocean Trench
Deadwater Docks
Cnidarian Reef
Lost Halls
Oryx's Sanctuary
The Shatters
These can be turned in to the Tinkerer for skins, UT’s and other booty!

[h3]Gold and Plunder[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/8d6502fd4b5f76f99add9a043e93bdcf17794562.png[/img]

As a reward for participating in these events, you will be able to get your hands on a number of new UT’s. These are:
Parrot Skeleton Scepter
Crossbones Skull
X-Marks-the-Spot Spell
Tome of Piracy
Ship's Wheel Shield
Brine Quiver
 
[h3]Free Campaign[/h3]
The rewards for the free campaign are as follows:

Backpack x2

Backpack Extenderx2
Ambrosia -  x1
Forge Chest Unlocker - x1
Schematic x50

Seasonal Vault Expansion  x1

The second Week of the “Get Schooled” Event is over and you were able to reach all Milestones! All Community Bounties were met. You will be able to find a Free Pack in the Shop later today.

notes.title: Public Testing: O3 Changes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/44dd0f44ef56d95ac3b9a9ef025d95ff9c5f6e82.png[/img]

Realm Community

Depending on where you live in the world Easter is right in front of you. That's the perfect time to have a look at upcoming O3 changes on our testing environment, right? Right!

In order to test these changes, you will be able to jump into Oryx Sanctuary via portals in the Nexus. New ones spawn every 90 seconds.

The Testing Servers will open its gates on the 7th of April. We announce it once it opens on discord.

Let's have a look at some Designer notes and the changes to O3:

[h3]Oryx 3 Adjustments[/h3]

The Oryx 3 fight has shown a lot of issues as time progressed, generally, as time goes on we expect bosses to get more optimized. Oryx 3 however has in some cases been optimized to the point where the boss is incapable of attacking for the majority of the fight. The primary culprit of this is the counter/stagger system, as it currently exists dealing enough damage quick enough will instantly cancel any attack Oryx is doing and force him into a reset. Coupled with many instances where O3 is vulnerable to damage while not doing anything and you can blow away most of the fight with Oryx barely shooting a single bullet. The following changes should keep the majority of the fight intact while still rewarding good gameplay and patching up a lot of the above issues.

The O3 counter/stagger system has been fully retooled, now instead of getting the counter or stagger at the end of an attack, O3 will fully complete all of the attacks in a combo chain. When you hit a certain threshold of damage in each phase, o3 will go invulnerable for the remainder of the attack and add to a tally of times the threshold was reached in the combo, at the end of the combo O3 will enter a stagger state with a duration depending on how many of these thresholds were reached over the course of the combo.

The thresholds have been normalized to 2.5% for all O3 attacks, this is not a final value but was chosen to hopefully allow well-played solos to still hit these thresholds on occasion. Additionally, if a stagger happens near the end of one of the O3 phases (roughly every 20% hp) it will allow you to cut into the next phase by up to 5% of O3 max health, thereby speeding up the subsequent phase and not wasting a stagger that happens too close to that hp threshold.

O3 also no longer can roll combos with only 2 attacks, the new chances are 50% 4 attacks 25% 3 attacks 25% 5 attacks. Additionally, the chances for further Celestial phases in the fight have been changed, previously the phase had a 4% chance to trigger instead of any attack except the first one in a combo, if this continued into the new system it would interrupt a currently going on combo and reset the stagger counter. Instead, it now has a 15% chance to occur when Oryx is picking a new combo, but it cannot trigger twice in a row, or as the first combo after heavens. 

Counters have been entirely removed from the fight.

Invulnerability has been added to the windows at the start of attacks and between combos as O3 is resetting to the center. This should cut down on the “free” damage windows present in the fight as they had previously been contributing to the fight being steamrolled in higher dps groups.
As always, feel free to leave feedback on our social channels.

Realmers!

You have tested them in the past weeks and now it's time to enjoy them on our live servers. Seasonal Characters arrive in Realm of the Mad God! Keep in mind that Missions are not quite ready yet but will come in the very near future. Additionally, we have prepared an Event for you to chase to unlock some perks. But you have to play a seasonal character to take part in them!

[b][h1]Seasonal Characters[/h1][/b]

Seasonal Characters are characters which apply special rules for the duration of a season. Rules will be described before each new season.
Seasons have a defined start and end date that also will regulate Battlepass as part of our Seasonality feature.

Players will be able to create a regular character or use a seasonal one.
After the season is over, the character is automatically converted to a regular one.

[h1][b]Why play a Seasonal Character?[/b][/h1]

Seasonal Characters get a permanent +10% BXP bonus during the whole season. This means that, while you cannot equip gear obtained in the past, your progress is accelerated when playing them. This feature is however under development and will come at a later point.

Also, one of the most interesting aspects of Seasonal Characters is their exclusive access to Missions, another upcoming feature that will allow your Seasonal Characters to do certain tasks and obtain unique rewards and BXP, only available for the season. Regular characters cannot participate in missions though!

To find out everything about this update, have a look at our [url=https://remaster.realmofthemadgod.com/?p=3529]blog[/url].

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/60e4ebd8aae2311e0f2cd55711b040e31bae7f54.png[/img]

Spooky spooky Realmers!

The end of the month is approaching and this means we are ready to celebrate Halloween! Additionally, you might now be able to access our newest dungeon in Realm of the Mad God. The Sulfurous Wetlands created by MOONSHOOT! Make sure to enter the dungeon with the right attire and don't get yourself wet.

[h3]Nexus and God Reskins[/h3]

Our Nexus once again received a Reskin that fits more to the theme of Halloween. Additionally, some of our gods got hit by loose spells and transformed into their alter egos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/bcd1f9e3292ab24a023c4ec20e7a69ee38c106c7.png[/img]

[*] Vengeful Spirit
[*] Ghost Ship
[/list]

[h3]Sulfurous Wetlands Dungeon[/h3]

As a branch fell into the water, a faint sizzle played. Sinking deeper and deeper into the murky depths, the branch remained intact, almost as if it yearned to ingrain itself at the bottom of the acidic bog. After a short wait, it hit the mire's floor, becoming one of the many interconnected pieces of the warped puzzle. The sphere of influence grew for the now dormant heart. Solitude across the generations has led to only involuntary expansion. The failure of a curse, the madness spawned from the desire for power, both culminated to this endpoint. 

Suddenly, a new energy emerged seemingly out of nowhere. The roots of the once beloved willow tree rustled beneath the muddied earth, almost as if it was reaching out to reclaim the days of old. 
Welcome to the Sulfurous Wetlands.

The Wetlands will be dropping from a new godlands mob: The Grand Dragonfly, with its availability being akin to mobs such as the Sting Spider, Corsair Crab, and Great Owl. It shares a similar difficulty level as the counterparts above and aims to give the area another challenging yet rewarding experience.

Special thanks are going out to everyone involved in creating this dungeon!

notes.title: Update 3.1.0.0 - Shatters Rehearsal
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/7c03f3f215f793c1f12324476d08fffa3fe81cb1.png[/img]

Realmers!

Time is running and we are getting closer to the end of the year. Recently Month of the Mad God ended and also our Back to School Event found its end. Now its time to jump into the Shatters Rehearsal Event! Fight our three Shatters Bosses separately, learn their mechanics and receive some of the new loot! You can find out everything you need to know about the Shatters Rehearsal, new ST Sets, Battlepass Season 2 and so much more down below.

[h2]Shatters Rehearsal[/h2]

We know some of our players might want to learn Shatters, but find learning not one but three bosses a bit overwhelming. Thinking of them, we have decided to create the Rehearsal Dungeon Mods for Shatters.
Rehearsal mods cannot be accessed normally nor through key refining. For the moment you will be able to access these mods during special event periods like the one described below.

[h2]The Rehearsal Dungeon Modifiers:[/h2]

They allow you to enter a portion of Shatters where you will fight one of the three bosses. The rest of the dungeon is not accessible in a Rehearsal version.

This bossfight is a modified version, its difficulty scaling is reduced from the regular Shatters and has the following modifiers across all enemies in the shatters.

[olist]
[*] 20% reduce damage
[*] 15% less health
[*] The loot of the bossfight is altered from the regular Shatters.
[/olist]

[h2]Shatters Rehearsal Loot[/h2]

The regular loot from the Shatters will not drop from a Rehearsal Version. Instead, the Rehearsal Shatters have a chance of dropping Rehearsal version of the items. These items have similar mechanics, and albeit powerful on their own, they aren’t as powerful as their “true” counterparts from the regular Shatters. 


For a list of all our changes and fixes have a look at our [url=https://remaster.realmofthemadgod.com/?p=3467]blog[/url]!

notes.title: Update 3.0.2.0 - End of MotMG
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/adfa5904251c7df2d6f383f96b9a06d4198d0a2a.png[/img]

Realmers!

It is time to ring the bells for the end of the Month of the Mad God! We all enjoyed weeks full of events and fighting the Syndicate. We have received a lot of feedback regarding the Interregnum event and the Mercenaries fights. More on how we will proceed with this event in the future down below. Also, don't forget to turn in your Marks and Black Coins! We are extending the time you can turn them in, but after that they will not have any use.

[h3]Vindication[/h3]

Mercenaries have been removed from the Realm, they can still appear in dungeons as a dungeon mod. You can use your Interregnum Keys that you still have left anywhere, new keys do not drop for now. Here is a detailed overview of the changes:


[list]
[*] Mercenaries do not spawn in the realm anymore.
[*] Mercenaries can still spawn in dungeons but now they have a dungeon mod which will be randomly selected from the regular pool of dungeon mods available. All of them are Grade A mods and they can appear in:
[*] “Pirate Queen Ramm” can appear in Forbidden Jungle, The Hive, Ancient Ruins, Sprite World, and Snake Pit.
[*] “Izel the Grand Shaman” can appear in Puppet Master’s Theatre, Undead Lair, Mad Lab, Abyss of Demons, Haunted Cemetery.
[*] “Nefret the Pharaoh” can appear in Parasite Chambers, Woodland Labyrinth, Deadwater Docks, Mountain Temple, The Third Dimension.
[*] “Black Blade Ozuchi” can appear in Fungal Cavern, Crystal Cavern, The Nest, Cultist Hideout, The Void, Lost Halls, The Shatters.
[*] The Shady Vagrant does not appear anymore in the Quest Room nor in the realm.
[*] Black Coins won’t drop anymore.
[*] Interregnum Keys can be used without the Shady Vagrant being near.
[*] New Interregnum Keys, for now, are not available. We plan to give access to Interregnum again in the future as part of special temporary events.
[/list]
 
[h3]About Interregnum Marks and Black Coins[/h3]

[b]If you have a Hidden Interregnum Key or stacks of Black Coins, we suggest you trade them for rewards at the Tinkerer as you won’t be able to use it. [/b]

The Shady Vagrant has left the nexus and the realm, satisfied by your work. We suggest you use this time to exchange your unused Black Coins and Interregnum Marks as you won’t be able to use them anymore for the foreseeable future. While it’s possible we bring the event back at some point, we probably won’t use the same mechanic.

For that, we are extending the time of the quests by 1 week.

[b]We suggest not keeping these items as they won’t be usable in the foreseeable future.[/b]

[h3]New Skins:[/h3]

https://imgur.com/a/jwNrxOW
[list]
[*] Sharpshooter Archer Skin
[*] Tiny Captain Summoner Skin
[*] Syndicate Hellhound Pet Skin
[*] Oni Clan Warrior Skin
[*] Desert Occultist Summoner Skin

[*] Boatswain Necromancer Skin
[/list]

[h3]Free Pack[/h3]

The following pack will be available in the shop for all players starting from today, until the 13th of September. The pack is a reward for not only reaching the goal for the Syndicate Infiltration Event, but surpassing it with a whopping 206.232 points!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3384862/e72d436b09dddf7f9284fd5e2227926818bd3c86.png[/img]

As for the Top 10 000 Infiltrators, there was definitely some steep competition for top placements. Before sending out the rewards, we would need a few days to verify the final results, make sure everything is correct. Once we have the final placements and all rewards have been sent to your Gift Chests, we’ll make sure to inform you via our usual socials

[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Quest Chests will now drop new weapons UTs.
[*] Shatters' Archmage will be immune to Dazed status effect.
[*] The Nexus is back to its old version.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Some sheaths and lutes were incorrectly tagged which interfered with the loot system in some cases, altering their drop chances in some particular enemies. This has been fixed.
[*] The Lightshow Scepter was missing a label, which meant it could not be used to forge an ST Ability in the forge. This has been fixed.
[*] Changed Ice Cave’s Inner Cave map to avoid the very infrequent bug where a player could become stuck in the wall.
[*] Visual fixes on several icons, particularly some lore books.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Dye Mask on the Tidal Wave Kensei Skin.
[*] Resolved an Issue with an Error Message appearing when claiming all milestones in the Battlepass.
[*] The limit for player names was increased from 10 to 15. 
[*] Modded Keys now display the percentage of value of chance to generate a particular mod.
[*] The daevite progenitor is now receiving the 150% boost when using the flames of genesis.
[*] Fixed a visual issue with XP Boosts when changing characters.
[*] The Burial Blades tooltip now only shows the info about 2 Bullets not 3.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Frost Ronin Samurai Skin Sprites.
[/list]
